753:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sorry to disappoint! I'm not $$ミカゲ$$, I'm not about to throw my life away over one heartbreak!」

753:t_135:2.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Besides, I don't need to be reborn. I'll find a new love with my own strength!」

753:t_135:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That resilience of yours is endearing.」

753:t_135:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then disappear, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! If the world ends, I can't even fall in love!」

753:t_135:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We don't want a new world! What we want is the future of this lovable world!!」

753:t_136:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$... Knowing love has made you strong.」

753:t_136:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I know everything. That includes you and $$アンディ$$, of course.」

753:t_136:3.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Hey! What do you think you're doing with people's privacy!?」

753:t_136:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Who cares, $$ＭＩＸ$$! Let's show that self-proclaimed god our love!」

753:t_136:5.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Okay, $$アンディ$$! Lend me your strength!」

753:t_136:6.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「To protect the world where I live with the one I love, I'll take $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ down with my own hands!!」

753:t_137:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「Let's go, $$ユノハ$$! To put an end to all the fighting!」

753:t_137:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You've grown strong, $$ユノハ$$. Is that the power of love too?」

753:t_137:3.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's right! $$ジン$$ gives me courage and strength!」

753:t_137:4.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm sure you, who don't know what it is to love, could never understand!」

753:t_137:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am a god. A god is a being who knows everything.」

753:t_137:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's a lie! Someone who knows what it is to love would never sit silently and watch the universe perish!」

753:t_137:7.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'll fight you! To protect this world where people who love each other live, together with $$ジン$$!!」

753:t_138:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$サザンカ$$... Be embraced in my arms, and welcome the new world.」

753:t_138:1.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「That handsome smile, that handsome voice... I'm getting dizzy...」

753:t_138:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「But, absolutely not! A character this refreshing isn't my type!」

753:t_138:3.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「In a world where everyone's desperate to live, a god who's the only one sparkling? No thank you!」

753:t_138:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You would reject my salvation for a reason like that?」

753:t_138:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Inspiration is what matters in this stuff! Handsome or not, you're my enemy!!」

753:t_139:0.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I already gave up this life once. I have no hesitation in staking everything on this battle.」

753:t_139:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Stop this futile struggle, $$シュレード$$. A life you seized beyond causality... Meet your final moment in peace.」

753:t_139:2.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Sorry, but I don't know the meaning of giving up. Even soaked in blood, I'll keep struggling until my final moment...!」

753:t_139:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「My life, play your melody now! Con fuoco, appassionato!」

753:t_139:4.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Forge the future! That is the ultimate melody!!」

753:t_140:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$クレア$$... Could it be that you can see the future?」

753:t_140:1.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$ once said: fill in the pages beyond the Book of Genesis yourselves.」

753:t_140:2.en:
$$クレア$$
「That's why we fight! Not to follow the fate we were given, but for the future we ourselves desire!」

753:t_140:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even if what awaits beyond it is despair?」

753:t_140:4.en:
$$クレア$$
「Changing that is the power of humans!」

753:t_140:5.en:
$$クレア$$
「And the first step is... $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! Surpassing you!」

753:t_141:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シンジ$$... If you accept me, you too will be freed from your suffering. All of your sins will be purified as well.」

753:t_141:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The universe will be reborn. You can be reborn there as a new self.」

753:t_141:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Throwing something away just because I failed... is running away...」

753:t_141:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I got in an EVA, all kinds of things happened, and... I lost all kinds of things, but there's one thing I figured out...」

753:t_141:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away...! If I do, nothing will ever change!」

753:t_141:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's right, $$シンジ$$. That is the truth.」

753:t_141:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And then you will learn that what awaits there is despair.」

753:t_141:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm going anyway...! I want to believe there's something beyond that!」

753:t_142:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can fill the gap in your soul.」

753:t_142:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... The hole in your heart that you feel.」

753:t_142:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「By accepting me, that hole will be filled, and you will become human.」

753:t_142:5.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「...But that's something I have to do myself...」

753:t_142:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A doll rejects a god?」

753:t_142:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「I'm not a doll...」

753:t_143:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アスカ$$... That left eye of yours, too...」

753:t_143:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「For someone playing god, you've got not a shred of delicacy, mister!」

753:t_143:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「No matter how much power you have, I'm not about to be looked after by a guy who thinks he's the only special one!」

753:t_143:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If that is your wish, I will grant it. I will make you vanish here.」

753:t_143:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「How long are you going to keep looking down on everyone!?」

753:t_143:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Just you wait! I'll smash this big lump, drag you out, and make you apologize!」

753:t_144:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Every world has a guy like this, putting on a smug face like he's the only one who understands everything.」

753:t_144:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Are you talking about that man at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$?」

753:t_144:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Slamming reality into guys like that is a total blast, you know!」

753:t_144:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I wonder if you can really do it, $$マリ$$?」

753:t_144:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「That's it! That face is what ticks me off!」

753:t_144:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「So that's that! For the final showdown, I'm going all out, dead serious!」

753:t_145:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ガロード$$... If I said I would carry you and $$ティファ$$ to a new universe...」

753:t_145:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then what about $$パーラ$$...」

753:t_145:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You call yourself a god and you're this stingy! If you're going to say something, say you'll save everyone in this whole universe!」

753:t_145:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you can't do that, quit being a god!」

753:t_145:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You understand nothing. The collapse of the universe is also a chance for life to start over.」

753:t_145:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What chance!? Who wanted that... who wanted to die!?」

753:t_145:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I won't accept that! Everyone overcomes hardship and sorrow and lives with everything they've got!」

753:t_145:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Lend me your strength, $$ティファ$$! To protect this world... to protect everyone, I'll defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_146:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You can watch the universe perish with a smile...!?」

753:t_146:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can, because I have the resolve to bear that sorrow and grief as well.」

753:t_146:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ロラン$$... Your revered $$ディアナ・ソレル$$ is the same. She has played that role, seeing lives off in that way.」
